results.title: Bangladesh, Italy eye MoU on fisheries, livestock and blue economy cooperation
results.description: Bangladesh has expressed interest in strengthening cooperation with Italy in fisheries and livestock, with a focus on aquaculture, livestock production, marine fisheries, and the blue economy. The issue was discussed at a bilateral meeting between State Minister for Fisheries and Livestock Sultan Salauddin Tuku, MP, and Luigi D'Eramo, Italy's undersecretary of state for Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Forests, today (21 September) on the sidelines of an event at the headquarters of the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) in Rome, according to the press release. results.title: The Icons Publishes New Report Highlighting Taiwan's Emergence as a Trusted Partner in the Global Satellite Economy
results.description: Taipei, Taiwan--(Newsfile Corp. - September 21, 2026) - The Icons has published a new report examining Taiwan's evolving role in the global satellite industry, with a particular focus on the country's transition from supplying individual satellite components toward integrated ground terminals, complete communications links and commercially deployable applications.

results.title: Ladakh’s village heads get over 233% hike in monthly emoluments
results.description: Ladakh’s village heads, locally known as ‘Gobas’, are in for a major financial boost; their monthly emoluments being increased more than three-fold from Rs 1,500 to Rs 5,000 after Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena approved the long-pending revision on Monday.
